title: 3D Novelty and Ideas Graph — QMLEEG
summary: Conceptual and methodological structure formalized in proposal r04. A classical spatial-temporal EEG backbone feeds a circular Data Re-uploading circuit on 4 qubits for ADHD classification, with channel-time saliency from exact gradients.

nodes.label: QMLEEG: hybrid DRU network
nodes.desc: A hybrid quantum-classical classifier with circular data re-uploading (DRU) for ADHD diagnosis from 19-channel EEG.
nodes.rhetorical_question: How can ADHD be classified from EEG beyond the expressivity limit of shallow NISQ circuits?
nodes.paragraph_text: QMLEEG couples a spatial-temporal convolutional backbone f_phi with an L-layer DRU circuit on 4 qubits, trained end-to-end with a subject-weighted loss.
nodes.metrics: Proposal r04 published, with 9 numbered equations. Benchmark: IEEE Dataport ADHD dataset (121 subjects).
nodes.novelty_claim: Fourier expressivity of degree L on 4 qubits, with channel-time saliency from exact gradients.

nodes.label: Gap: EEG variability and barren plateaus
nodes.desc: Inter-subject EEG variability and the limited expressivity of single-layer quantum encodings degrade generalization.
nodes.rhetorical_question: Why do shallow quantum encodings fail on complex biomedical signals?
nodes.paragraph_text: A single angle encoding limits each feature to Fourier frequency one, while deeper circuits risk barren plateaus.
nodes.metrics: Limitation documented by Schuld et al. (2021) and EEG-TACT (2026).
nodes.novelty_claim: A 4-feature classical bottleneck small enough to measure the circuit's gradient variance directly (E3).

nodes.label: Spatial-temporal backbone f_phi
nodes.desc: Compresses 19-channel EEG epochs into 4 features bounded to the rotation domain, one per qubit.
nodes.rhetorical_question: How can 128 Hz multichannel EEG be coupled to a register of few qubits?
nodes.paragraph_text: The parameterized map f_phi: R^{19 x T} -> [-pi, pi]^4 learns generic features; whether they track Theta, Beta, the Theta/Beta ratio or frontal coherence is contrasted post hoc.
nodes.novelty_claim: Feature dimension matched to the qubit register, with no physiological meaning imposed by the architecture.

nodes.label: DRU quantum circuit and CNOT ring
nodes.desc: Unitary U(x, theta, beta) = prod_{l=1}^L W_l(theta_l) S_l(x, beta_l) with unit-scale encoding R_y(x_j + beta_{l,j}) and a circular CNOT ring.
nodes.rhetorical_question: How can representational capacity grow without adding qubits?
nodes.paragraph_text: Re-uploading x in each of L layers makes every expectation value a truncated Fourier series with integer frequencies from -L to L per feature.
nodes.novelty_claim: Fourier expressivity of degree L on 4 qubits; the ring entangles every bipartition, though not all of them maximally.

nodes.label: Gradient saliency interpretability
nodes.desc: Saliency I(c, t) = |sum_k (dy_hat/dx_k)(df_phi/dX_{c,t})| mapped to electrodes and time samples.
nodes.rhetorical_question: How can a quantum classifier be made clinically explainable?
nodes.paragraph_text: Exact gradients (backpropagation in simulation, the parameter-shift rule on hardware) link the prediction to fronto-central channels Fp1, Fp2, F3, F4, Fz and Cz.
nodes.novelty_claim: A direct physiological audit of the decision.

nodes.label: Baseline: EEG-TACT (2026)
nodes.desc: A deep learning model with temporal attention and convolutional tokenization for ADHD identification in children.
nodes.rhetorical_question: What is the reference baseline on the 121-subject dataset?
nodes.paragraph_text: EEG-TACT reports 87.5% subject-level accuracy on the IEEE Dataport ADHD dataset.

nodes.label: Theory: data re-uploading (2020)
nodes.desc: Pérez-Salinas et al. showed universality through sequential data re-uploading.
nodes.rhetorical_question: What grounds universality with few qubits?
nodes.paragraph_text: A single qubit or a few qubits with re-uploading approximate any continuous multivariate function.
nodes.novelty_claim: Extension to the spatial-temporal EEG domain.
